svg.title: Trading risk disclaimer
svg.desc: This bot is an experiment built for fun. It can lose money. Use at your own risk. The config optimizer can generate overfitted results that fail in live trading.

text.tspan: This bot is an experiment built for fun. It is not financial advice or a safety-tested product.
This bot can lose money. Use it entirely at your own risk.
Do not assume backtests, paper trading, or live execution will be profitable.
The config optimizer can generate overfitted strategies that collapse out of sample.
You are responsible for configuration, deployment, monitoring, and capital risk.
